name: Ibuki Ren
source: A transfer student at Ryousuke's school. She doesn't know about Ryousuke, nor that all the girls in school are fleeing from him after he receives his sex card. When he catches her unaware he uses his card and forces her into sex. This starts their relationship on the wrong foot.
